enumDescriptions: Manual permissions: ask when approval settings don't apply.
Assisted permissions: evaluate risk before running tools.
Allow all: run available tools without asking, subject to managed policy.

read.description: Use read-only repository tools when enabled for the workspace.

edit.description: Request approval to edit files in the workspace.

run.description: Request approval to run a command.

browser.description: Use VS Code's native Integrated Browser tools when advertised by the editor. On by default for native launch profiles; off otherwise.

sandbox.description: Override the terminal sandbox at launch. Native launch profiles inherit chat.agent.sandbox.enabled; other roles default to sandboxed. Unsandboxed commands can read and write files and use the network as the workspace host user.

promptForApproval.description: Legacy roles only; use launch.approvals for native approval controls. Set to false to approve allowed workspace edits or commands without dialogs.

browserPreviewPorts.description: Obsolete. VS Code now controls browser access.
browserPreviewPorts.deprecationMessage: Remove browserPreviewPorts. Agent Teams uses VS Code's native browser tools and does not apply a separate port list.

defaultRecipientRoleId.description: Optional ID from roles. Prefer this role for unaddressed human posts when it is a connected, unpaused room member.

defaults.description: Shared role settings. Each role can override individual fields.

launch.description: Share native Copilot preferences for roles that declare launch. Unset values fall back to chat.defaultConfiguration.

roles.description: Workspace roster. This replaces the default roster.

id.description: Unique, stable role ID used for assignments and rooms. Release an assigned role before changing its ID.

name.description: Unique display name, other than You.

description.description: Role responsibilities shown to the team and given to the worker.

prompt.description: Optional instructions for this role's worker. Do not include secrets.

launch.description: Opt this role into native Copilot launch or override shared launch preferences. Unset values fall back to chat.defaultConfiguration.

permissions.description: Override individual shared workspace permissions. Role IDs never grant tool access.
